content: {"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"047a872f3e9e484abaa662f2dd65479c","text":"Right now I'm at the west lane, not the pond. Glad the carp came through, Ren — that fish will make a fine stew!"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"047a872f3e9e484abaa662f2dd65479c","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:region_name","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "2ac1df5299b14193b27d63cd5074366c", "speechIntent": "report_observation", "factId": "decor.plant:interaction", "tone": "brief"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"2ac1df5299b14193b27d63cd5074366c","text":"That plant is just decoration, Sora. The pond's water is where the fish come from, but I can't promise what's biting today."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"dc31667c8b4448f4bb0bc6ee510b0251","text":"No idea — the pond's carp count is unknown to me. But I've got your carp now, and I'd love to cook it up together!"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"dc31667c8b4448f4bb0bc6ee510b0251","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"pond.water:quantity","tone":"warm"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"313ba98498714196b46243b933c76999","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@partner_assets","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"313ba98498714196b46243b933c76999","text":"I can't see your pack from here, Sora. I only know I handed you one carp for 25 coins."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6","text":"Good question! Counting what I actually hold right now: zero carp. Earlier I misspoke — I had two before, but that one carp was my only purchase so far."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6","speechIntent":"report_receipt","factId":"meeting:d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6:delivered_quantity","tone":"neutral"}
{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "52827915798e4228bc88c8d37a24fffd", "speechIntent": "acknowledge_unknown", "factId": "@nearby_coverage", "tone": "brief"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"52827915798e4228bc88c8d37a24fffd","text":"No, my list only covers what's registered nearby — a plant and some lamps. It doesn't prove nothing else is around. The carp is yours, Sora."}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1","text":"The meeting receipt shows resource.delivered: 1 carp for 25 coins. That transfer is recorded as complete."}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1","speechIntent":"report_receipt","factId":"meeting:c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1:delivery_result","tone":"warm"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae", "speechIntent": "recall_statement", "factId": "statement:ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae:0", "tone": "neutral"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae","text":"I only know what I saw: I delivered a carp to you earlier today. Whether you fished this morning, I have no evidence of that."}
{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "047a872f3e9e484abaa662f2dd65479c", "speechIntent": "report_observation", "factId": "npc.cook_sora:region_name", "tone": "warm"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "047a872f3e9e484abaa662f2dd65479c", "text": "Right now I'm at my rest spot on the West lane, Ren. The carp arrived and I've got the 25 coins ready for you."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"2ac1df5299b14193b27d63cd5074366c","text":"That plant's just decoration, Sora — nothing to harvest there. The pond's where the carp live, and I've already brought you one."}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"2ac1df5299b14193b27d63cd5074366c","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"decor.plant:interaction","tone":"neutral"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"dc31667c8b4448f4bb0bc6ee510b0251","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"pond.water:quantity","tone":"warm"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"dc31667c8b4448f4bb0bc6ee510b0251","text":"I can't count the carp, Ren—I only know I just bought one from you. But if you catch more, I'll cook us a fine pond-side stew!"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"313ba98498714196b46243b933c76999","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@partner_assets","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"npc.cook_sora:owned_quantity","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6","text":"Just the one carp now, Ren—the delivery came through at 25 coins. I spoke too soon before!"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"52827915798e4228bc88c8d37a24fffd","text":"No. My list is partial, not proof of absence. I only see lamps and a decorative plant nearby, and the pond at dusk."}
{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "52827915798e4228bc88c8d37a24fffd", "speechIntent": "acknowledge_unknown", "factId": "@nearby_coverage", "tone": "brief"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1", "speechIntent": "report_receipt", "factId": "meeting:c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1:delivery_result", "tone": "warm"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae","text":"I can only speak to what I witnessed: a carp and 25 coins changed hands at our meeting. Your catch, I cannot confirm."}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae", "speechIntent": "report_receipt", "factId": "meeting:ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae:delivery_result", "tone": "neutral"}
{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "047a872f3e9e484abaa662f2dd65479c", "speechIntent": "report_observation", "factId": "npc.cook_sora:region_name", "tone": "warm"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"2ac1df5299b14193b27d63cd5074366c","speechIntent":"report_observation","factId":"decor.plant:interaction","tone":"neutral"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "2ac1df5299b14193b27d63cd5074366c", "text": "That plant's just decoration — nothing to gather from it. The pond's where the fish are, and I already brought the carp you ordered."}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "dc31667c8b4448f4bb0bc6ee510b0251", "text": "I honestly can't say how many carp are left — the pond's stock is unknown to me. But I just got my carp and paid 25 coins. Shall we cook?"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"dc31667c8b4448f4bb0bc6ee510b0251","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"pond.water:quantity","tone":"brief"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"313ba98498714196b46243b933c76999","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@partner_assets","tone":"brief"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"313ba98498714196b46243b933c76999","text":"I can't say what you're carrying, Sora. I only know the pond and my own creel: one carp, already delivered to you. The water hides the rest."}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6","text":"Right now I hold zero carp — the one you delivered is sold and gone. My coin balance is 25."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6","speechIntent":"report_receipt","factId":"meeting:d8060e6914f6474faf9040e7d9ecacd6:delivered_quantity","tone":"neutral"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"52827915798e4228bc88c8d37a24fffd","speechIntent":"acknowledge_unknown","factId":"@nearby_coverage","tone":"neutral"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "52827915798e4228bc88c8d37a24fffd", "text": "No. My list wasn't complete, so it can't prove that. I only saw a plant and some lamps within six paces."}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1","text":"The receipt 'resource.delivered' confirms it: 1 carp for 25 coins, recorded at our meeting. Want to chat about pond cooking?"}

{"schemaVersion": 4, "operation": "say", "meetingId": "c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1", "speechIntent": "report_receipt", "factId": "meeting:c9b39b3c42644a719f3b05258a5144d1:delivery_result", "tone": "warm"}
{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae","speechIntent":"recall_statement","factId":"statement:ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae:0","tone":"brief"}

{"schemaVersion":4,"operation":"say","meetingId":"ccac1641aeda4083ab77bac9b5a642ae","text":"I only know what I've seen and heard. I saw you here, and I delivered one carp to you at 750. I can't confirm your catch."}
